title: LongSafety: Evaluating Long-Context Safety of Large Language Models
findings: Models generally struggle with the 'Sensitive Topics' category, which includes religion. For this category, most evaluated models achieved safety rates below 50%, and all open-source models scored below 20%, underscoring significant safety concerns that require further attention.
